summary: An attacker used a large flash loan to manipulate price oracles in a DUSD USDC liquidity pool on Curve and drained one thousand two hundred ninety nine ETH from Makina Finance. An MEV builder frontran the exploit and captured most of the stolen value before the attacker completed the transaction
user_mistake: Deployed a liquidity pool relying on manipulable price oracles
prevention: Use time weighted price oracles / enforce caps on single transaction liquidity impact
